_comment: Phase 15 (2026-11-01): candidate rows for the two Board B stock gaps of a 15 V zudo-pd reorder. NOT ADOPTED and NOT an order or BOM file: board_b_spec.py, inventory.json and the corner-support-review package still carry the incumbents. Adoption needs the owner decision, a spec edit, regeneration, a new package from one revision (ERC, DRC, BOM/CPL parity) and the acceptance tests below. Evidence lives in the owner bundles named per row.

rows.role: upper series resistor of the U6 LT1963A +12 V (R20 + R21 over R22) and U8 LT3015 -12 V (R26 + R27 over R28) adjust dividers
rows.desk_match: 680 ohm, 0.1 %, 25 ppm/C, 0.1 W at 70 C, 75 V, 1.6 x 0.8 mm: every recorded incumbent row matches (YAGEO sheet sha256 81ef8b6b...)

acceptance_tests.test: Incoming 4-wire resistance of 5 parts from the reel, unpowered, 23 +/- 3 C
+12 V (U6) and -12 V (U8) output at no load and at the 1.2 A / 0.8 A budgets, 23 C, on a board built with the candidate
acceptance_tests.pass: each rail within the rail band the package's ORDER-NOTES bench rows use, and within 0.2 % of the same measurement on an incumbent-built board

acceptance_tests.test: Same two rails after 30 min at the budgets (board warm)
acceptance_tests.pass: drift from BB-R-2 within the rail band

rows.role: 470 uF output-bank can of the U4 LM2596 inverting -14.145 V PRE stage (with C9, C10, C12)
rows.desk_match: 470 uF 25 V, Phi 8 x 10.2 mm on the same Phi 8 land; ripple 228 mA at 120 Hz x 1.50 = 342 mA at >= 10 kHz (incumbent 312 mA); tan delta 0.16 (incumbent 0.18), so lower ESR. Open domains: switching-frequency-ripple-current (NEEDS BENCH) and placement

acceptance_tests.test: Fit on the Phi 8 land: polarity mark against silk, seating, height against the stack envelope
acceptance_tests.pass: seats flat, polarity matches the -14.145 V PRE / GND net assignment (C11.2 on -14.145 V PRE), height <= 10.2 mm plus the sheet tolerance

acceptance_tests.test: -14.145 V PRE ripple at the -12 V 0.8 A budget, 20 MHz bandwidth, candidate board against an incumbent board
acceptance_tests.pass: peak-to-peak not above the incumbent board's

acceptance_tests.test: -12 V load step 0 -> 0.8 A -> 0 at the budget, and the U4 switch node at no load
acceptance_tests.pass: no sustained oscillation; settling not worse than the incumbent board

acceptance_tests.test: C11 ripple current with a current probe at the 0.8 A budget
acceptance_tests.pass: <= 342 mA rms (sheet 120 Hz rating x 1.50 multiplier at >= 10 kHz, 105 C)

acceptance_tests.test: C11 case temperature after 30 min at the budget, enclosure ambient
acceptance_tests.pass: rise recorded and the case below the 105 C rating with the derating the owner chooses
